1. Server Components vs Client Components
• Server components execute exclusively on Node.js/Edge runtime.
• Client components hydrate with interactive state (useState, useEffect).

Action Hooks & Optimistic UI
useActionState(fn, initialState)
useOptimistic(state, updateFn)
Note: Always validate form formData on server before database mutation.

• Minimal boilerplate, no Context Provider wrapping needed.
• Atomic selectors prevent wasteful component re-renders.
• Middleware support: persist (LocalStorage / IndexedDB), devtools.
